children: Oracle said it has expanded its Digital Assets Data Nexus platform with payment execution integration, configurable wallet and smart contract controls, and AI-driven transaction monitoring and risk analysis. According to Odaily, the upgrade is designed to connect banks' existing payment systems with digital asset trade execution through the ISO 20022 messaging standard.

The company said it plans to integrate Oracle Banking Payments and Swift Ledger, with coverage for tokenized deposits, stablecoins, CBDC, digital bonds, and real-world assets. The related functions are scheduled for release in fiscal 2027.

title: Oracle Expands Digital Assets Data Nexus With Payment Execution and AI Monitoring Tools
